generate_tfrecords_from_csv: run the script to generate TFRecords of SequenceExample from raw videos listed in a CSV file
extract_frames_from_video: extract a list of JPEG bytes from a video file between start and end timestamps using ffmpeg
extract_audio_from_video: extract raw mono audio as a float list from a video file using ffmpeg
generate_sequence_example: generate a TensorFlow SequenceExample with encoded frames, audio, labels, and metadata from a video clip
add_bytes_list_to_sequence: add a bytes list feature to a TensorFlow SequenceExample feature list by key
